nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function, let $p \ge 1$, and let $q_{\min}$ and $q_{\max}$ be integers. For every $x \in K$ and every number $f$ of the binary format with $p$-bit significands and last-place exponents in $[q_{\min}, q_{\max}]$, the rounding $\mathrm{fl}(x)$ of $x$ to nearest, ties to even, with $p$-bit significands satisfies $|\mathrm{fl}(x) - x| \le |f - x|$.
nodes.title: Round to nearest in a bounded format

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function and let $p \ge 1$. For every $x \in K$ and every binary floating-point number $f \in K$ with a $p$-bit significand (and unbounded exponent), the rounding $\mathrm{fl}(x)$ of $x$ to nearest, ties to even, with $p$-bit significands satisfies $|\mathrm{fl}(x) - x| \le |f - x|$: no floating-point number is closer to $x$ than $\mathrm{fl}(x)$.
nodes.title: Round to nearest for floating-point numbers

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function and let $p$ be a natural number. For every $x \in K$, the rounding $\mathrm{fl}(x)$ of $x$ to nearest, ties to even, with $p$-bit significands satisfies $|\mathrm{fl}(x) - x| \le u\,|x|$, where $u = 2^{-p}$ is the unit roundoff.
nodes.title: The relative error bound

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function, let $p \ge 1$, let $x \in K$ be nonzero, and let $e = \lfloor \log_2 |x| \rfloor - (p - 1)$ be the exponent of the last place of $x$. Then $|\operatorname{rne}(x / 2^e)| \le 2^p$, where $\operatorname{rne}$ rounds to the nearest integer, ties to even.
nodes.title: Bound on the rounded significand

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function. For every $m \in K$, the integer $\operatorname{rne}(m)$ obtained by rounding $m$ to the nearest integer, ties to even, satisfies $|\operatorname{rne}(m) - m| \le 1/2$.
nodes.title: Rounding to the nearest integer is within one half

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function. For every $m \in K$, the integer $\operatorname{rne}(m)$ obtained by rounding $m$ to the nearest integer, ties to even, satisfies $|\operatorname{rne}(m) - m| \le m - \lfloor m \rfloor$ and $|\operatorname{rne}(m) - m| \le \lfloor m \rfloor + 1 - m$.
nodes.title: Rounding error bounded by the distances to neighbouring integers

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function. For every $m \in K$ and every integer $k$, the integer $\operatorname{rne}(m)$ obtained by rounding $m$ to the nearest integer, ties to even, satisfies $|\operatorname{rne}(m) - m| \le |k - m|$: no integer is closer to $m$ than $\operatorname{rne}(m)$.
nodes.title: Round to nearest integer

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function, let $p$ be a natural number, let $x \in K$, and let $e$ be the exponent of the last place of $x$, which is $\lfloor \log_2 |x| \rfloor - (p - 1)$ for $x \ne 0$. If the rounding $\mathrm{fl}(x)$ of $x$ to nearest, ties to even, with $p$-bit significands satisfies $|\mathrm{fl}(x) - x| = 2^e / 2$, then the integer $\operatorname{rne}(x / 2^e)$, the…
nodes.title: Ties to even for floating-point rounding

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function, let $m \in K$, and let $\operatorname{rne}(m)$ be the integer obtained by rounding $m$ to the nearest integer, ties to even. If $|\operatorname{rne}(m) - m| = 1/2$, that is, $m$ is halfway between two consecutive integers, then $\operatorname{rne}(m)$ is even.
nodes.title: Ties to even for the nearest integer

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function and let $p$ be a natural number. Let $x, y \in K$ and let $m_x, m_y, e_x, e_y$ be integers with $|m_x| < 2^p$, $|m_y| < 2^p$, $x = m_x 2^{e_x}$ and $y = m_y 2^{e_y}$. If $y / 2 \le x \le 2y$, then there is an integer $k$ with $|k| < 2^p$ and $x - y = k \cdot 2^{\min(e_x, e_y)}$.
nodes.title: The difference of floating-point numbers within a factor of two

nodes.summary: Let $p \ge 1$ and let $x$ be an element of a linearly ordered field with a floor function. If $x$ is a binary floating-point number with a $p$-bit significand, that is, $x = m \cdot 2^e$ for some integers $m$ and $e$ with $|m| < 2^p$, then rounding $x$ to nearest, ties to even, at precision $p$ returns $x$: $\mathrm{fl}_p(x) = x$.
nodes.title: Floating-point numbers round to themselves

nodes.summary: Let $p \ge 1$ and let $x$ and $y$ be binary floating-point numbers with $p$-bit significands in a linearly ordered field with a floor function. If $y / 2 \le x \le 2y$, then rounding $x - y$ to nearest, ties to even, at precision $p$ returns it exactly: $\mathrm{fl}_p(x - y) = x - y$.
nodes.title: Floating-point subtraction is exact under Sterbenz's condition

nodes.summary: Let $x$ be an element of a linearly ordered field with a floor function, let $p$ be a natural number, and let $e$ be the exponent of the last place of $x$ at precision $p$. Writing $\operatorname{rne}$ for rounding to the nearest integer with ties to even, the rounding $\mathrm{fl}_p(x)$ of $x$ to nearest, ties to even, at precision $p$ has the error…
nodes.title: The rounding error at the scale of the last place

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$ and an element $x$ of a linearly ordered field with a floor function, let $e$ be the exponent of the last place of $x$ at precision $p$, and let $\operatorname{rne}$ round to the nearest integer with ties to the even one. The rounding of $x$ to nearest, ties to even, is $\mathrm{fl}_p(x) = \operatorname{rne}(x / 2^e) \cdot 2^e$: scale $x$ so that its last place is the units digit, round to…
nodes.title: Round to nearest, ties to even

nodes.summary: Let $p \ge 1$. For every element $x$ of a linearly ordered field with a floor function, the rounding $\mathrm{fl}_p(x)$ of $x$ to nearest, ties to even, is a binary floating-point number with a $p$-bit significand: $\mathrm{fl}_p(x) = m \cdot 2^e$ for some integers $m$ and $e$ with $|m| < 2^p$.
nodes.title: Rounding gives a floating-point number

nodes.summary: Let $p \ge 1$, let $q_{\min}$ and $q_{\max}$ be integers, and let $x$ be an element of a linearly ordered field with a floor function. If $2^{q_{\min} + p - 1} \le |x|$ ($x$ is at least the smallest normal number) and $|x| \le (2^p - 1) \cdot 2^{q_{\max}}$ ($x$ is at most the largest finite number), then the rounding $\mathrm{fl}_p(x)$ of $x$ to nearest, ties to even, is a number of the binary format with $p$-bit…
nodes.title: In the normal range, rounding stays in the format

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a natural number, let $q_{\min}$ and $q_{\max}$ be integers, and let $x$ and $y$ be numbers of the binary format with $p$-bit significands whose last place has exponent in $[q_{\min}, q_{\max}]$ (subnormal numbers included), in a linearly ordered field with a floor function. If $y / 2 \le x \le 2y$, then $x - y$ is also a number of this format.
nodes.title: Sterbenz's lemma in a bounded format

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$ and integers $q_{\min}$ and $q_{\max}$, an element $x$ of a linearly ordered field with a floor function is a number of the binary format with $p$-bit significands and last-place exponents in $[q_{\min}, q_{\max}]$ when $x = m \cdot 2^e$ for some integers $m$ and $e$ with $|m| < 2^p$ and $q_{\min} \le e \le q_{\max}$. These are zero, the subnormal numbers and the normal numbers of the format.
nodes.title: Floating-point numbers of a bounded format

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a natural number and let $x$ and $y$ be binary floating-point numbers with $p$-bit significands (and unbounded exponent) in a linearly ordered field with a floor function. If $y / 2 \le x \le 2y$, then $x - y$ is also a binary floating-point number with a $p$-bit significand.
nodes.title: Sterbenz's lemma

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$, an element $x$ of a linearly ordered field with a floor function is a binary floating-point number with a $p$-bit significand and unbounded exponent when $x = m \cdot 2^e$ for some integers $m$ and $e$ with $|m| < 2^p$.
nodes.title: Binary floating-point numbers

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function, let $m \in K$ and let $k$ be an integer. If $k \le m$, then $k \le \operatorname{rne}(m)$, where $\operatorname{rne}(m)$ is $m$ rounded to the nearest integer with ties to even.
nodes.title: Rounding to nearest preserves integer lower bounds

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function, let $m \in K$ and let $k$ be an integer. If $m \le k$, then $\operatorname{rne}(m) \le k$, where $\operatorname{rne}(m)$ is $m$ rounded to the nearest integer with ties to even.
nodes.title: Rounding to nearest preserves integer upper bounds

nodes.summary: For $m$ in a linearly ordered field $K$ with a floor function, $\operatorname{rne}(m)$ is the integer $\lfloor m \rfloor$ if $m - \lfloor m \rfloor < 1/2$, the integer $\lfloor m \rfloor + 1$ if $m - \lfloor m \rfloor > 1/2$, and, when $m - \lfloor m \rfloor = 1/2$, whichever of $\lfloor m \rfloor$ and $\lfloor m \rfloor + 1$ is even.
nodes.title: Nearest-integer rounding with ties to even

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a linearly ordered field with a floor function, let $p \ge 1$ be a natural number and let $x \in K$ be nonzero. Let $e = \lfloor \log_2 |x| \rfloor - (p - 1)$ be the exponent of the last place of $x$ for $p$-bit significands. Then $2^{p-1} \le |x / 2^e|$ and $|x / 2^e| < 2^p$.
nodes.title: Bounds on the scaled significand

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$ (the significand length) and $x$ in a linearly ordered field $K$ with a floor function, the exponent of the last place of $x$ is the integer $\lfloor \log_2 |x| \rfloor - (p - 1)$. Here $\lfloor \log_2 |x| \rfloor$ is the integer logarithm: the largest integer $n$ with $2^n \le |x|$ when $x \ne 0$, and $0$ when $x = 0$.
nodes.title: Exponent of the last place

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
